value.title: Stakeout and free-point tools use WGS84 distance, WMM2025 magnetic azimuth and transient overlays
value.statement:
Stakeout accepts selected Point/MultiPoint, LineString/MultiLineString and Polygon/MultiPolygon geometry in EPSG:4326 or EPSG:3857 without mutating the feature. The indexed private copy chooses the nearest planar EPSG3857 segment/boundary point; polygons include outer/inner boundaries even when the current fix is inside. The selected point returns to4326; reported metres/true initial bearing normally use the WGS84 ellipsoid inverse, with an explicit inverseSphere nonconvergence fallback. This is not a proof of global ellipsoidal nearest-point or all-input accuracy. While stakeout is active, an owner-based high-frequency location lease sets minDistance to zero and restores ordinary user settings after the final release. Audio is scheduled by monotonic time, stops for stale fixes and never uses network fixes for precision bands. GPS and Android mock fixes use distance-based bands even when the receiver bridge publishes a coarse accuracy placeholder; the reported horizontal accuracy remains visible in the widget and the final cue requires two consecutive fresh in-tolerance fixes. Audible bands use a full-scale-limited short damped tap with 3x digital gain and the final state a double tap, not a sustained high tone. A location foreground service, ongoing silent notification and partial wake lock keep GPS and audio active while the screen is off or the UI is paused; explicit stop releases all three. Ordinary guidance uses only the location service type without Bluetooth permission. Synchronous and asynchronous start rejection release the owning GPS/audio resources; stale session starts/stops cannot cancel a newer owner. Unowned redelivery fulfils the foreground-start contract before stopping without restoring GPS/audio. The same live lifecycle is available from current location to an arbitrary map point. A separate arbitrary point A to point B mode does not acquire GPS/audio resources. True initial bearing is converted to numeric magnetic azimuth by subtracting WMM2025 declination at the start plus the persisted east-positive user correction; coincident points have undefined azimuth. Direction uses only the filtered device rotation-vector magnetic compass, never movement bearing; without a live compass it keeps the arrow screen-correct by subtracting an explicitly enabled map bearing from true bearing. Free-point markers and segment are transient MapLibre layers below the user-location cursor, never project features. Both static endpoints and the live target are draggable; the live GPS start is not editable. The map widget does not duplicate object name or coordinate source. Process death never silently restarts audible guidance or restores half-selected free points.
 The selection input and panel/lock presentation have maplibui ownership; target math remains in maplib and lifecycle/UI in app. Target geometry is copied, with no layer/FID/workspace token; a later row/FID update is not an automatic target subscription. Bundle/process-marker restore, source/DB changes and boundary-versus-inside user goals remain in existing AUDIT-TODO-NGW-REPLACE-FID until an independent policy/witness is chosen. Layer isLocked is not DATA_SYNC exclusion.
